constraints.definition: CHECK (((((remainder = (0)::numeric) AND (bubble_user_id IS NULL) AND (bubble_position IS NULL)) OR ((remainder > (0)::numeric) AND (bubble_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (bubble_position = (ticket_award_count + 1)) AND (bubble_position <= field_size))) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: tournament_satellite_settlements_check7
constraints.definition: CHECK (((target_was_missing IS FALSE) AND (target_contract_version IS NULL)))

constraints.name: tournament_satellite_settlements_target_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (target_id) REFERENCES tournaments(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: tournament_satellite_settlements_tournament_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (tournament_id) REFERENCES tournaments(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
